api_url.title: API URL
api_url.description: LLM API URL used to write the log (leave empty to use the main LLM)

api_key.title: API Key
api_key.description: LLM API key (leave empty to use the main LLM's key)

model.title: Model name
model.description: Model used to write the log (leave empty to use the main LLM's model)

thinking_mode.title: Thinking mode
thinking_mode.description: DeepSeek V4 thinking mode: enabled turns it on, disabled turns it off

reasoning_effort.title: Thinking effort
reasoning_effort.description: DeepSeek V4 thinking effort: high or max. max is the deep-thinking Max mode

diary_folder.title: Log folder
diary_folder.description: Folder for AI log files. Use a path relative to the app folder (like AI记录室/AI日志) or an absolute path

diary_filename_template.title: Log file name template
diary_filename_template.description: File name template for daily logs. {date} is replaced with the date (like 2026-03-16)

monthly_filename_template.title: Monthly summary file name template
monthly_filename_template.description: File name template for monthly summaries. {month} is replaced with the year and month (like 2026-03)

core_memory_file.title: Core memory file
core_memory_file.description: Path of the core user memory file. Relative to the app folder (like AI记录室/核心用户记忆.txt) or absolute

conversation_history_file.title: Chat history file
conversation_history_file.description: Path of the chat history (memory log) file. Relative to the app folder (like AI记录室/记忆库.txt) or absolute. The main app writes it. The AI log plugin reads it, then backs it up and clears it after writing the log

history_backup_folder.title: Memory log backup folder
history_backup_folder.description: After writing the log, the memory log file is backed up to this folder (relative or absolute path). Backups are named 记忆库-{date}.txt, and the original is then cleared. Leave empty to skip backups.

daily_prompt.title: Daily log prompt
daily_prompt.description: Custom system prompt for writing the AI's daily log. Leave empty for none.

monthly_prompt.title: Monthly summary prompt
monthly_prompt.description: Custom system prompt for the monthly summary. Leave empty for none.

trigger_after_hour.title: Log start hour
trigger_after_hour.description: Daily logs are only written after this hour (24-hour clock, for example 21 means 9 PM)

max_retries.title: Max API retries
max_retries.description: Max retries when an API call fails

night_hour_start.title: Night cutoff hour
night_hour_start.description: Times before this hour (after midnight) count as the previous day (an integer from 0 to 7)
